g.text: Redundancy divides downtime. Dependencies multiply it.
Every component you add makes it worse.
In PARALLEL — any one will do
Every copy you add makes it better.
Nines are multiplicative down a dependency chain.
A 99.99% service behind three 99.9% dependencies is not 99.99%.
Parallel only helps if the copies fail INDEPENDENTLY.
Three instances in one rack share a power supply.
